a copy of web's statement and the plan being enacted are posted here for convenienece:
```Web spreads out the various letters and other notes. They take a deep breath and begin.
“Would like to start with an apology. Mostly to Sandigill, though he no longer in town. Many of us too focused on own individual problems and goals, could not focus on bigger picture. Could not focus on town. I no exception. Worried too much about petty issues. Should have had this meeting days ago. Maybe could have stopped war even earlier. I am sorry.” Web pauses, looking out at all those assembled, then continues.
“The Urucockra and Chinookin are assembling. For war. Have been corresponding with Halfwudgie elder for a few days. Started out with asking about Halfwudgie burial rites for one killed by dire bear. Became more useful, talking about relations. Learned today from him exactly how to stop flooding. Uru have begun killing bird messengers so will not get more information now. In temple, there is lodestone. Similar as ones had to remove to free Bahamut and stop grease. He believes will end flooding, and that will stop war. Web agree. Believe that if temple fixed Chinookin be able to breed and Uru not be flooded. Hopefully will prevent war.”
Web pauses again. ```

```“Chinookin lead by Fishmother and Urucockra lead by oligarchy, most powerful is Longclaw. If they meet in battle, consequences disastrous. Web believe from history and talk from other Chinookin that these leaders not always leaders, or not always like are now: cruel, vain. Web worry that hunger involved to make them like this. Hope simply mortal desires and could be united against hunger. If not, may have to unite those under rule without help from leaders. But know that Longclaw respect might and Fishmother respect supplication. Will be tricky.”
“Sandigill has left to be with Chinookin. Believe he determined if war could not be stopped, would rather be with his people.”
Web takes another breath. 
“Propose that we send groups to both forces separately, in order to secure safer passage to temple. Can offer Urucockra end to flooding and Chinookin return of breeding grounds. Can mention to both previous experience removing lodestones. Then enter temple and remove lodestone, hopefully stopping war. Should succeed, may be able to bring Fishmother and Longclaw to peace table, discuss hunger.”
Web sighs. “Thoughts?”```
(Love how you wrote ‘web pauses’ in the note :p)

```Will be leading expedition to temple to remove lodestone and stop flooding, hoping to improve relations with both Chinookin and Urucockra. Will approach with stealth, hoping to remain unnoticed.```
(it's like court record. includes pauses.)

Two notes are placed by a zombie, who then returns to <#739055141759615027> :
```Sandigill, our judge, council member, and friend, has died. Those wishing to pay respects can find his remains at the oasis. It saddens me not to be able to treat his death with the full mourning it deserves, but we will need to be strong and not let ourselves falter for his sake. His vacancy on the council will need to be filled soon, as much as that pains me to say. Those wishing to be considered for the position or nominate another for it can send a notice of such to the town hall. These coming times have been hard and will continue to be rough. Our strength comes from our unity, as Sandigill tried so desperately to remind us. All the best, 
     -Web, truthseeker ```

```The expedition to the temple today has shown mixed results. THe island is slowly rising and the flooding has stopped. But we are now barred from entering the temple at the lake of woes, a rule citizens are strongly encouraged to follow. Our relations with the fishmother cannot afford to get worse. The death and replacement of Longshadow by Empty Hill is also a potential issue, though hopefully our contact with the halfwudgies will remain open now that the fighting is over. Our situation is dire, but we may yet prevail.
    Your eyes and ears always,
            -Web, truthseeker. ```

```To all town residents: following the successful tests of raising the dead outside of town walls, raising the dead is now conditionally legal. As such, the council requests that all citizens leave a simple will in their dwelling, part of which specifies their wishes for their body after death. If no such will is to be found, the decision will be made by those closest to the deceased.
Best Wishes,
       -Web, truth seeker. ```

```Making your way in the world today, takes everything you got.  Taking a break from all your worries, It sure would help a lot.  Wouldn't you like to get away?  Sometimes you want to go, Where everybody knows your name and they're always glad you came.  You want to be where you can see the troubles are all the same.  You want to be where everybody knows your name.

Do you miss taking a few minutes when off work to have a drink?  Do you miss having friends laugh and have a good time where you don't have to clean up?  Would you like to hear stories, music, and entertainment told by a Raconteur?  Do you miss getting ||(Smudged ink)||faced on the daily?  Come on down to the Broken Sub Pub, where Heki will serve you.  Feel free to stop by anytime, but officially tomorrow we reopen.```

```The mission of those named Chad has proved successful. Not only is councilmember Web no longer petrifying, the Tatankans have been lifted from their curse. Following an impromptu meeting, the following information has been learned:
1: Deaths on the island, unless eaten soon after death, grow the power of the hunger. Traditionally the Urucockra would perform this rite to weaken the hunger, but they have not been doing so and are now greatly weakened.
2: The town and the Tatankans are now officially allied. Both seek peace on the island and hope to fight the hunger.
3: The Tatankans call the hunger 'he who walks behind'.
4: Oleander, the lich who cursed the Tatankans, has raised a giant monster that is believed will be used to attack the Tatankan's home. They have requested that all available citizens help in repelling the beast later today.
5: Citizens are free to visit the Tatankan pens, but should be respectful of their customs and not act rashly.
All the best, 
         -Web, truthseeker. ```
```If there are any clues as to where the Hunger will appear, please let me know. We need to prepare. - Lady Lilia ```

```  Two great and storied organizations have set up branches in our town: The Knights du Rui Soleil and The Freemasons. These organizations have their differences, but also have a long and peaceful tradition of allying against destructive forces. Eclipse Knight Florian Chapelle and the late Archivist Llewllyn ap Daysong were great friends in particular. Recently, some tensions have flared up between members of the two groups. Regardless of any division between the groups or previous enmity, the current leaders of both factions have resolved to work together towards their common goal: defeating the hunger for good. Cooperation is essential to our survival and prosperity. Thank you for your steadfast efforts.
Yours in prosperity and determination,

I've said it before and I'll say it as many times as I have to: forgiveness is what seperates us from them. Does that make anything he did ok? *Nope.* But if it results in Solomon not hurting people, and better yet, no hunger, then I say we take the chance.

I will not be with you all at the final fight. Someone has to stay behind to protect the forge. I trust that we will have a future beyond tomorrow, so I will be protecting Saturday, and Sunday, and the other days to come.

Whatever you choose, all I ask is that you do it out of love, and not hate.

Sincerely,
~Leaf```
